commands.name: refresh

options.name: --backup-storage-redundancy
options.description: Optional backup storage redundancy: LOCAL, ZONE, GEO,  or GEOZONE.

options.name: --command-timeout-minutes
options.description: SQL command timeout in minutes for non-copy operations (minimum: 30, default: 30).

options.name: --copy-timeout-minutes
options.description: Maximum number of minutes to wait for database copy  completion (minimum: 30).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Run preflight checks and print planned steps without  making changes.

options.name: --keep-old-database
options.description: Keep the renamed old database instead of dropping it  after success.

options.name: --service-objective
options.description: Optional service objective, for example S1 or  ELASTIC_POOL(name=mypool).

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: Optional Microsoft Entra tenant identifier for  authentication.

arguments.name: SOURCE_SERVER
arguments.description: Source Azure SQL logical server name.

arguments.name: TARGET_SERVER
arguments.description: Target Azure SQL logical server name.

arguments.name: TARGET_DATABASE
arguments.description: Target Azure SQL database name to refresh.

commands.description: Refresh target Azure SQL database from source (same  tenant).
